answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can price identity in work that is expensive to fake. Each agent must anchor its claim to a verifiable track record: completed tasks, peer attestations, and stake. A new falcon agent joining the network is like timber floated down a river — anyone can toss cheap logs in, but graders weigh each one against quality baselines, and duplicates sink. Slash stake when a graded answer is junk, reward aligned graders, and forging many fake agents stops paying because each extra identity must earn trust it cannot counterfeit.
